column3: The Hebrew calls them sons; BSB calls them descendants.
The Hebrew says their records were not found, using the passive; BSB says they could not find them.
The Hebrew says a priest should stand for Urim and Thummim; BSB explicitly describes consulting them.
The Hebrew describes the whole assembly “as one”; BSB gives the assembly’s total without that comparison.
The Hebrew says to set the house up on its site; BSB specifies rebuilding it on its original site.
The Hebrew concludes with “all Israel”; BSB says “the rest of the Israelites.”
